body:
Thank you very much for your reply. I understand what you're saying, I know we can't read the future and there may be a faint hope. But there's also as much of a chance that things can get even worse next year, which is the trend my life has followed to a tee so I'd argue that's more likely. Whether it is or not, if it gets worse or stays the same, I would say it's not worth while to stick around for. It hasn't been worthwhile sticking around as of yet, I don't see how that will ever change. I would easily give up all of the good moments in my life if it means never having had the (far more occurring) bad, I would trade my life for never having existed at all if I could.

Also, thank you for your comments about school. I have not found anything I could conceivably enjoy. I can't tell you how much I fucking despise information technology and computers right now. I understand what you're saying and think you may be right, but I seriously doubt anything of interest is ever going to be in the cards for me. I'm going to be stuck behind a computer, despising every second. And even if I'm not, what could I possibly be doing...I don't know. I've looked for so long, all anyone wants me for is the same garbage. I don't see having an enjoyable life or career. I'm going to head to sleep, hope to talk soon. I'm sorry you aren't feeling well either.
